claims.text: Most service businesses lose leads by responding too slowly
The Lead Response Audit is a free tool that requires no signup
It calculates a response score, monthly leads lost, and revenue at risk from four inputs

disclosure: Reflects widely documented speed-to-lead research patterns (e.g., published studies on lead response time and conversion). No single specific study is cited, and no invented sample sizes or precise percentages are used.

claims.text: Businesses that respond to a new lead within minutes close more of them than businesses that wait a day
Most businesses do not respond within minutes; response time is typically much longer than customers expect
